label: Redguard
description: Yokudan blood. The finest swords in Tamriel came with it.
notes: Skin colour is a tint on the shared vanilla body textures, which is how the game itself does it: every humanoid race uses the same meshes and the same diffuse, and differs by head morph, head normal, eyes and tint. No curated per-race texture tree is needed or wanted.
